name: bollinger_ema_sar_v2_short_only
change_from_v1: Removed the requirement to sell only after sweeping/breaking above a prior structural high
The mirrored LONG structural-low sweep gate is removed from the general strategy definition
The 3-candle exit now requires three consecutive candles in the trend color: red for SHORT
All other V1 conditions remain fixed
session_rule: No hard 09:00-12:00 ET gate. NY anchor is contextual only.

market_regime_filter.slope_definition_v2: EMA20 must be falling on each of the last 3 closed transitions for SHORT
market_regime_filter.note: Slope rule is unchanged from V1 and is not optimized in this run.

signal_candle.rocket_short: Red body and upper wick >= 70% of body size.
signal_candle.engulfing_short: Red body fully engulfs the prior candle body.

entry_conditions_short: Prior bar or signal bar reaches/pierces upper Bollinger band
EMA20 is falling on each of the last 3 closed transitions
EMA3 crosses below EMA9 on the signal bar
Parabolic SAR is above the signal candle
Signal candle is rocket rejection or bearish body engulfing
removed_entry_condition: NO requirement to sweep/break above a prior structural high before selling.

entry_execution.timing: Open of the bar immediately after the fully closed signal candle

stop.short: High of the candle immediately before the signal candle

exit_v2.target: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth measured at signal close, projected downward from entry
exit_v2.three_candle_exit: Exit at the close of the third consecutive bearish (red) candle after entry if target or stop has not triggered first. A green/doji candle resets the consecutive-red count.

ema50_ema200.role_v2: Recorded as context only, not mandatory entry gates
